observed: runtime records request receipts before model execution and serializes admission across processes
identical request IDs return the same run while changed content conflicts
process loss interrupts unfinished work rather than automatically repeating external effects
ambiguous decisions are reported as indeterminate
records.derived_pattern: Before an effectful operation, persist immutable request identity and admission state; do not replay ambiguous external effects merely because execution continuity was lost.
records.behavioral_consequence: For future effectful workflows, prefer pre-effect durable receipts, idempotent identity, and explicit OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/indeterminate handling over optimistic replay.

observed: the SAT/SMT core treats theory atoms as abstract objects and communicates through explicit interfaces
theory solvers report conflicts and propagation with explanations
multiple theory solvers can be composed behind an interface while preserving distinct responsibilities
records.derived_pattern: A general reasoning system benefits when core search and domain-specific reasoning communicate through explicit contracts carrying conflicts and explanations.
records.behavioral_consequence: When composing specialist reasoning modules, require typed claims/conflicts/explanations instead of allowing opaque specialist output to silently become global truth.

observed: plugin checks may make the correctness gate stricter but cannot remove or relax built-in findings
one failing/malformed plugin check is isolated while other checks still run
records.derived_pattern: Extension-level validation may tighten a global correctness floor but should not weaken it; faulty extensions should be isolated.
records.behavioral_consequence: Treat domain-specific reviewers as monotonic constraint adders unless they carry explicit authority to revise the base invariant; one reviewer failure must not erase other evidence.

observed: coroutine suspension is explicit in the type/call syntax
state is retained in the receiver and resumes under controlled rules
crossing a possible suspension point drops facts involving receiver or arguments while preserving local-only facts
records.derived_pattern: Crossing an asynchronous/external-state boundary should invalidate assumptions tied to mutable external objects while preserving facts whose validity does not depend on that boundary.
records.behavioral_consequence: After tool calls, waits, reconnects, or external effects, revalidate mutable/current state instead of carrying pre-boundary assumptions forward automatically.

observed: crate swapping supports live evolution and fault recovery
the implementation documents state transfer and relocation/dependency rewrites
the source explicitly warns that correct operation after a swap is not guaranteed and leaves compatibility responsibility to the caller
records.derived_pattern: Successful live replacement of a component is not evidence that semantic compatibility or system correctness survived the replacement.
records.behavioral_consequence: Never equate hot-swap/source replacement success with qualified continuity; require post-change compatibility and behavior verification.
